classification.difficultyReason: Find the outer missing side by Pythagoras, recognise nested triangles sharing an angle, and use corresponding-side ratios and base subtraction to obtain the remaining lengths.

spec.description: Triangle PLM with altitude LN and a dimension arrow spanning the whole base PM. Source blue geometry is rendered black under house style.
spec.mathematics: PL=2, PM=10/3, angle PLM=90 degrees and LN perpendicular to PM. N lies between P and M. No units are supplied.

answer.worked:
By Pythagoras' theorem in right-angled triangle $PLM$,
$$\begin{align*}LM^2&=PM^2-PL^2\\LM^2&=\left(\frac{10}{3}\right)^2-2^2\\LM^2&=\frac{64}{9}\\LM&=\frac{8}{3}.\end{align*}$$

answer.short:
$\dfrac{8}{5}$

Use the matching-side ratio of the similar triangles.
answer.worked:
$\angle PNL=\angle PLM=90^\circ$ and $\angle LPN=\angle LPM$ because $P,N,M$ are collinear. Thus $\triangle PNL\sim\triangle PLM$ by AAA. Matching sides give
$$\begin{align*}\frac{LN}{LM}&=\frac{PL}{PM}\\\frac{LN}{8/3}&=\frac{2}{10/3}\\LN&=\frac{8}{3}\times\frac{3}{5}\\LN&=\frac{8}{5}.\end{align*}$$
